question: My relationship manager said 'you'll get an OTP, approve the next screen.' What did I approve?
text: The consent framework documents don't specify what the OTP or approval screen authenticate in the flow. Without knowing what application or service you were using—and what was shown on the "next screen" before you approved—I can't tell you what consent or transaction you authorized. If this was Account Aggregator consent, the consent artefact must show who will receive data, what data, and for what purpose, but whether those details were displayed to you before or after the OTP isn't spelled out in the RBI directions.
